format: HTML with embedded JavaScript and CSS
description: This is an HTML file for a web-based database viewer interface. It includes styles, layout, and client-side scripting to load and display database names, tables, and table data dynamically via API calls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, reset UI state, and fetches fresh data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles expansion/collapse of a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with headers and rows based on fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated preview.
